items.description: Leak detection and opening of the bathroom wall next to the washbasin
items.rationale: Covered under 2.1: locating the leak and opening the wall to reach it. Reference Case 21 (leak detection and opening) supports indemnity for similar work.

items.description: Replacement of split copper supply pipe section, 15 mm, incl. fittings
items.rationale: Covered under 2.2: repairing the fractured pipe. Reference Cases 18 and 21 show similar pipe repair lines indemnified at this level.

items.description: Closing the wall opening, re-plastering and re-tiling approx. 0.2 m2
items.rationale: Covered under 2.3: restoring damaged plaster and tiles to previous condition. Reference Case 21 (final site cleaning, transition pieces, and minor restoration) supports indemnity for this type of repair.

items.description: Annual service and descaling of the gas boiler in the hallway
items.rationale: Explicitly excluded by 3.1: maintenance, servicing or descaling of installations, even if carried out during the same visit. Not related to the insured peril.
